verifiedRuleText.grouping: R1 organizer pairing in two groups; R2/R3 same initial group; R4 opposite group
verifiedRuleText.roundFive: maximize ranking distance in elimination matches
verifiedRuleText.elimination: 3-2 teams choose remaining 2-3 opponents in Swiss rank order
verifiedRuleText.playoffSeeding: eight qualifiers ordered by final Swiss ranking
verifiedRuleText.limitation: Published prose does not specify a deterministic optimization algorithm or weighted percentage rounding formula.

observedInitialPairing.limitation: A/B is interpreted from literal official node names, corroborated by later same/cross-group matches. No separate initial numeric seed table or organizer decision audit is present.
